name: Drug Policy Alliance
summary: The largest US organisation campaigning to end the war on drugs, based in New York with offices in California, New Jersey, New Mexico and Washington, D.C. It campaigns for marijuana legalisation, drug decriminalisation and overdose prevention (harm-reduction centres, drug checking), drafts model laws, hosts the biennial International Drug Policy Reform Conference and makes grants to partner campaigns. Its sister organisation Drug Policy Action, a 501(c)(4) whose gifts are not tax-deductible, runs its lobbying and ballot campaigns and keeps separate accounts.
